domain_rationale: Correctness is decided by incentive-compensation practice in a sales-finance function: crediting split deals by the rep's split, marginal quota bands with accelerators above quota, commission clawback on cancelled business within a window, a new-logo bonus, a recoverable draw whose recovery comes only from earnings above the draw, and a minimum payment carried forward. The deliverable is the quarterly commission statement sales finance pays reps from, not software behaviour for its own sake. No task in workspace/tasks, workspace/dropped or workspace/revision computes sales commissions (a search for 'commission' across all three and the reports found only this batch's prompt); the delivered supplier-rebate-settlement task settles supplier rebates in a distributor's procurement (Operations/Supply chain), a different party, deliverable and rule set, and the accepted royalty and rebill references are music royalties and utility billing.
evidence: instruction.md: fix the package so it prints 'the quarterly commission statements our Field Sales Compensation Plan gives'; the plan is 'the authority for these statements'; symptoms are pay outcomes on shared deals, over-quota quarters, cancellations, new customers, small payments and draw repayments
environment/app/docs/compensation-plan.md: a numbered compensation plan (reversal, new-logo order, age of a credit note; bookings, commission bands, clawback, new-logo bonus, draw and payment)
planned verifier: whole-statement comparison against expectations sealed from solution/model.py, derived from the plan
task.toml: category Operations, subcategory Finance, tag finance-sales-compensation
